title: Subadditivity of the weights of integer multiplicity currents: μ_{X + cY} ≤ μ_X + μ_Y for |c| ≤ 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and X, Y, Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with integer multiplicity representations R_X, R_Y, R_Z in U (IMRep U n). Let c ∈ ℝ with |c| ≤ 1, and suppose Z(ω) = X(ω) + c·Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then the weights satisfy μ_Z ≤ μ_X + μ_Y as measures on ℝ^P, where μ_• := R_•.measure = θ_•Hⁿ⌞M_•. That is, μ_Z(E) ≤ μ_X(E) + μ_Y(E) for every E ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (RX RY RZ : IMRep U n) (c : ℝ), IsOpen U → |c| ≤ 1 → RX.Represents X → RY.Represents Y → RZ.Represents Z → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = X ω + c * Y ω) → RZ.measure ≤ RX.measure + RY.measure
